t: Everything here is practice, and nothing reaches a real student.
First, choose how you want to rehearse: as a teacher, or as a student.
A teacher starts with nothing at all, just as you would in Classroom.
So create your class. Give it a name, and it opens with its own class code.
Use Stream to share announcements. Write a message, post it, and see where it appears.
Create a topic, then file an assignment beneath it so students can find their work.
People is where you invite students.
They stay Invited until they join, exactly as they would in the real thing.
Grades fills in once there are students and work to mark.
Need support? Open Practice Help for an explanation, guided steps, or this walkthrough.
Review what you tried and decide what needs more practice. There is no score.
Reset whenever you want, and start the whole thing again.
